About the job

Prospecting & Lead Generation Specialist (B2B, Apollo & Sales Navigator Expert) - 100% Remote




Apply here: https://wisevas.io/work-with-us




Are you experienced in building targeted prospect lists and running cold outbound campaigns from start to finish? Do you know how to use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar platforms to identify the right decision-makers and turn cold prospects into qualified conversations?




We're looking for a Prospecting & Lead Generation Specialist to support a fractional CFO firm serving founder-led businesses across real estate, professional services, and technology-enabled companies. This is a hands-on outbound prospecting role, not an account management, customer success, or general administrative position.




About the Role

You'll be responsible for building and maintaining targeted prospect lists, executing cold outreach through LinkedIn and email, managing multi-touch follow-up sequences, qualifying responses, and booking discovery calls directly into the founder's calendar.




This role is ideal for someone who has personally built lead lists, researched prospects, run outbound sequences, and managed the prospecting process end-to-end. You won't be responsible for pitching or closing deals — your focus is creating a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.




The position is approximately 20 hours per week, fully remote, with some daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.




Responsibilities

Build and maintain targeted B2B prospect lists based on a defined Ideal Client Profile (ICP).
Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify companies, decision-makers, and qualified prospects.
Use Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales intelligence platforms for list building, prospect research, and contact enrichment.
Run cold outbound campaigns through LinkedIn and email.
Build and execute consistent multi-touch outreach and follow-up sequences.
Personalize outbound messaging based on prospect and company research.
Qualify inbound responses generated through outbound campaigns.
Book qualified discovery calls directly into the founder's calendar.
Maintain accurate and organized prospect data in Excel, spreadsheets, or CRM systems.
Track lead status, outreach activity, follow-ups, and pipeline progression.
Report weekly on outreach volume, response rates, engagement, and booked discovery calls.
Continuously refine targeting, lists, and outreach execution based on campaign performance.
Take ownership of the outbound prospecting process with minimal day-to-day supervision.




What We're Looking For

2–3+ years of proven experience in lead generation, B2B prospecting, cold outreach, SDR, BDR, or a similar outbound-focused role.
Real, hands-on experience building prospect lists from scratch, not simply working leads already provided by a company.
Someone who has personally built target lists and run outbound sequences in Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar
Hands-on experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, including building, filtering, and saving targeted lead searches.
Experience using Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales intelligence and lead enrichment platforms.

Strong understanding of outbound sequencing, follow-up cadence, prospect research, and lead qualification.
Ability to identify the right companies and decision-makers based on an ICP.
Experience maintaining lead pipelines and prospect data in Excel, spreadsheets, or CRM systems.
Excellent written English, with the ability to write professional outbound messages.
Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working independently.
Results-oriented mindset with an understanding of outbound metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, engagement rates, and booked meetings.
Experience prospecting into real estate, property management, professional services, or B2B financial services is a strong plus.
Availability for some daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.




Do NOT Apply If

Your background is primarily in Account Management, Customer Success, or Customer Service without significant cold prospecting experience.

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

Descripción de la empresa

En Doctoralia, nuestra misión es humanizar la experiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología. Como la plataforma líder en el mercado mexicano y referente global en soluciones SaaS para el sector médico, conectamos a millones de pacientes con especialistas, transformando la práctica clínica en una experiencia digital eficiente y centrada en el paciente.

Estamos buscando un Retention Customer Success apasionado, estratégico y con mentalidad de crecimiento para ser el aliado clave de nuestros especialistas.

Descripción del rol

Ser Retention Customer Success en Doctoralia es mucho más que gestionar solicitudes de baja: es transformar momentos críticos en oportunidades de impacto real dentro del sector salud.

Eres la voz humana detrás de una plataforma SaaS que digitaliza la salud y la hace más humana. Acompañas a los especialistas cuando más lo necesitan, entendiendo su contexto, analizando su perfil y proponiendo soluciones personalizadas que alinean sus objetivos con los de Doctoralia, generando relaciones de largo plazo basadas en datos, empatía y confianza.

Aquí no retenemos por obligación, sino por valor:


Disminuimos el churn con estrategias inteligentes y personalizadas.
Recuperamos clientes entendiendo su negocio y sus necesidades reales.
Convertimos incidencias de pago y fricción en experiencias positivas.
Aseguramos que cada especialista aproveche al máximo la plataforma.


Este rol es ideal para personas que disfrutan negociar, analizar y resolver, que se sienten cómodas en entornos dinámicos y que buscan que su trabajo tenga un propósito real y medible en la vida de miles de pacientes y especialistas.

Responsabilidades clave


Analizar las razones de posible baja de especialistas y diseñar estrategias personalizadas para su retención, alineando sus necesidades con las soluciones que ofrece Doctoralia.
Implementar campañas y acciones proactivas dirigidas a reducir el churn, detectando y abordando señales tempranas de descontento o desuso de la plataforma.
Servir como consultor especializado, contactando oportunamente a los especialistas para brindar alternativas, resolver incidencias y asegurar un uso continuo y satisfactorio del producto.
Colaborar estrechamente con equipos internos (ventas, soporte, producto y marketing) para retroalimentar sobre tendencias, necesidades o bloqueos detectados en la experiencia de los especialistas.
Monitorear y reportar métricas clave de retención, identificando áreas de mejora y compartiendo insights que contribuyan a la evolución constante del proceso y la plataforma.


🎯Perfil Profesional


Experiencia: De 1 a 2 años en Retención y seguimiento de Carteras con alto volumen de clientes. (100-150 clientes).
ADN Tech: Te mueves como pez en el agua en entornos Startup, Marketing o Publicidad.
Data-Driven: Sabes leer datos, analizar campañas de Google Ads y usarlos para contar una historia de éxito.
Tech Stack: Dominas CRM, Zoom, Slack y el ecosistema de Google Workspace.
Soft Skills: Tienes una mentalidad orientada a la resolución de problemas, la empatía y la resiliencia en la retención de clientes.


Propuesta de Valor (Compensación y Beneficios)

Ofrecemos un entorno de alto rendimiento con una estructura de beneficios competitiva:


🏠 Esquema Híbrido: El equilibrio perfecto entre la energía de la oficina y la comodidad del home office.
🚀 Esquema de Comisiones: Plan de incentivos para recompensar tu capacidad de manejar cuentas.
🌴 Descanso Real: 22 días de vacaciones desde el año 1 + tu cumpleaños libre para celebrar.
🏥 Salud Primero: Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores para tu tranquilidad.
💰 Futuro y Beneficios: Fondo de ahorro y vales de despensa.
💪 Bienestar: Membresía en TotalPass & iFeel para tu bienestar físico y emocional.
🌍 Cultura Global: Proyección profesional en una empresa internacional con presencia en más de 13 países.


¿Estás listo para transformar el sector salud en México? ¡Queremos conocerte!

description:

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




Marketing Content Specialist at BairesDev




In this role, you'll develop, validate, and optimize the content and data that power the enterprise, ensuring accurate, compelling, and client-focused materials for commercial teams. - Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
About the job

About the Role

We are looking for a personable, technically capable Software Demo & Customer Onboarding Specialist to help roofing contractors successfully evaluate, adopt, and use our roofing CRM platform.




This is not a high-pressure sales position. Your job is to understand how a roofing company operates, demonstrate how the software can improve its workflow, and then help new customers successfully transition from their existing CRM or business systems onto our platform.




You will work directly with roofing company owners, managers, sales teams, office staff, and administrators. Once a company signs up, you will help guide them through setup, data migration, training, launch, and ongoing support.




The ideal candidate is comfortable on Zoom, learns software quickly, communicates clearly, and can patiently guide customers who range from highly technical to people who simply want someone to show them exactly what to click.




Key Responsibilities




Software Demonstrations

Conduct live Zoom/video demonstrations for roofing companies interested in the CRM.
Learn enough about each company's current process to tailor the demonstration to their needs.
Clearly demonstrate features, workflows, integrations, reporting, automation, and other capabilities.
Answer technical and operational questions during demonstrations.
Document questions or technical issues that need to be escalated to the development team.
Follow a standardized demo process while still making each presentation conversational and relevant.




Customer Onboarding




Once a roofing company becomes a customer, you will help take them from "we signed up" to "our team is successfully using the system."

Conduct onboarding and kickoff meetings.
Gather information about the customer's existing CRM and business processes.
Create and manage an onboarding checklist for each account.
Configure company information, users, permissions, workflows, pipelines, and settings.
Coordinate integrations with other software and services.
Help customers understand how their existing processes translate into the new CRM.
Train owners, administrators, salespeople, production teams, and office staff.
Conduct follow-up training sessions when necessary.
Track onboarding progress and make sure customers do not stall during implementation.




CRM Migration




Many customers will already be using another roofing or construction CRM. You will help coordinate their migration, including:

Understanding their existing CRM structure.
Identifying what information needs to be migrated.
Coordinating exports of customer, lead, job, contact, and other relevant data.
Reviewing data for completeness before migration.
Working with our technical team when more complex migrations are required.
Verifying migrated information with the customer.
Helping customers transition workflows from their previous CRM into the new system.
Making sure the customer understands what will and will not transfer before migration begins.




Technical expectation:




You do not need to be a software developer, but you should be technically comfortable and able to learn how CRM databases, integrations, imports/exports, and workflows operate.




Customer Support

After launch, you will also be one of the people customers can rely on for help. This includes:

Answering software questions through email, chat, phone, and video calls.
Troubleshooting basic user issues.
Helping customers configure or modify their accounts.
Creating short instructional videos or screen recordings when helpful.
Maintaining FAQs and internal documentation.
Identifying recurring customer problems that should be addressed through training or product improvements.
Escalating bugs and advanced technical issues to the appropriate team.
Following up with customers until their issue is resolved.




What We're Looking For




Required:

Excellent spoken and written English.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based business owners and executives.
Comfortable conducting live software demonstrations over Zoom or similar platforms.
Strong computer and general technical skills.
Ability to learn new software quickly.
Experience with CRM, SaaS, project management, or business software.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
Patient and professional when helping less-technical customers.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment.
Ability to work primarily during U.S. business hours.




Strongly Preferred:




Experience with one or more of the following:

Roofing or construction industry
Roofing CRM software
SaaS customer success
Software implementation
Customer onboarding
CRM migration
Technical customer support
Software training
Account management




Especially valuable platforms:

AccuLynx
JobNimbus
ServiceTitan
Roofr
Salesforce
HubSpot
GoHighLevel
CompanyCam
Similar systems




The Person Who Will Excel in This Position




You don't have to know everything about roofing or our CRM on day one. You do need to be someone who can learn a system thoroughly enough to confidently teach it to someone else.




"We're currently using another CRM. We have thousands of customers and jobs in there. Show me how your system works, explain how we're going to move everything over, and help me get my team using it."




Your job is to confidently guide that customer through the entire process.




Success in This Role

Quality and professionalism of software demonstrations.
Demo-to-onboarding handoff.
Speed of customer implementation.
Percentage of customers successfully completing onboarding.
Customer adoption and usage.
Migration accuracy.
Customer satisfaction.
Support response and resolution time.
Ability to independently resolve customer questions.
Quality of documentation and training materials.
Reduction in customers requiring repeated support for the same issues.




What matters most:




We care more about your ability to communicate, learn technology, solve problems, and work well with customers than having a specific degree.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

Job Description: Sales Development Representative

Company: Wendt Partners

 Contract: Two-month fixed-term contract

 Compensation: $1,500 

Start date: As soon as possible




Role Overview

Wendt Partners is seeking a proactive and results-oriented Sales Development Representative to support our business development efforts for a two-month period. The SDR will identify and engage prospective clients, qualify opportunities, and schedule meetings for the sales team.




Key Responsibilities

● Research and identify prospective clients that match our target customer profile.

● Conduct outbound prospecting through email, telephone, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.

● Engage decision-makers and communicate Wendt Partners’ services clearly and professionally.

● Qualify prospects based on their business needs, priorities, budget, and readiness to engage.

● Schedule qualified discovery meetings for the appropriate sales team members.

● Maintain accurate prospect, activity, and opportunity information in HubSpot.

● Follow up consistently with prospects across multiple touchpoints.

● Work from assigned target-account and contact lists while identifying additional opportunities.

● Meet agreed activity, conversation, qualification, and meeting-booking targets.

● Provide regular updates on outreach performance, prospect feedback, objections, and pipeline progress.

● Collaborate with sales and marketing colleagues to refine messaging and improve campaign results.




Required Qualifications

● Minimum 3 years of experience in sales development, outbound business development, lead generation, or a similar B2B sales role. 

● Fluent spoken and written English is required, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with international prospects.

● Demonstrated experience conducting outbound prospecting through telephone, email, and LinkedIn.

● Proven ability to engage senior decision-makers, qualify prospects, handle objections, and book qualified sales meetings.

● Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

● Ability to work independently, ramp up quickly, and deliver against short-term targets.

● Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate prospect and activity records.

● Reliable internet access and a professional remote-working environment.




Preferred Qualifications

● HubSpot experience or knowledge is strongly preferred.

● Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in sales, prospecting, research, or productivity.

● Experience selling B2B professional services, consulting, CRM, RevOps, SaaS, or technology solutions.

● Familiarity with account-based prospecting and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

● Experience prospecting to and communicating with international markets.

● Demonstrated success booking qualified meetings with decision-makers.




Success Measures

During the two-month contract, success will be measured through:

● Consistent completion of agreed prospecting activities.

● Quality conversations with relevant decision-makers.

● Qualified meetings booked and attended.

● Accurate and timely CRM updates.

● Contribution to a credible pipeline of sales opportunities.




How to Apply

Interested candidates must complete our online application form and provide all requested information, including details of their relevant sales and outbound prospecting experience.

Please ensure your application is complete and accurate before submitting it. 




Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within 10 days of submitting your application, please consider your application unsuccessful.

Medio tiempo · Remoto · México




Coralian Films AI Studio busca una persona inteligente, ambiciosa y organizada que quiera desarrollarse en la intersección entre cine, publicidad, negocios e inteligencia artificial.

Somos un estudio internacional que produce comerciales, animación, motion graphics y películas de marca mediante procesos híbridos de filmmaking e IA.

Esta es una oportunidad para trabajar directamente con los fundadores de la empresa, aprender cómo se construye y expande un estudio audiovisual y conocer de cerca el proceso completo de producciones reales: desde el primer contacto y el brief hasta el tratamiento, la producción y la entrega final.

• Aprender progresivamente sobre nuestros servicios, proyectos y procesos de producción.




La dirección proporcionará las listas de empresas y llevará las reuniones, propuestas, negociación y cierre. El puesto se enfoca exclusivamente en generar nuevas oportunidades para Coralian Films AI Studio.

• Excelente comunicación escrita y verbal en español.

• Iniciativa, curiosidad, resiliencia y criterio comercial.

• Conocimiento de LinkedIn, CRM y herramientas de prospección es deseable.

También consideraremos perfiles con poca experiencia formal que puedan demostrar inteligencia, iniciativa y una verdadera capacidad para aprender y conseguir resultados.

No buscamos ventas masivas de call center. Buscamos a alguien capaz de entender nuestro trabajo, investigar cada oportunidad y construir relaciones profesionales de manera humana y estratégica.




LO QUE OFRECEMOS

• Trabajo directo y mentoría con los fundadores de Coralian Films.

• Experiencia práctica en filmmaking, publicidad y producción con IA.

• Participación en el crecimiento de una nueva división del estudio.

• Acceso al proceso comercial y creativo de producciones reales.

About the job

About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

At Rippling, Sales Development is the driving force behind two main functions: pipeline creation and career development. We execute with a high level of urgency to partner with marketing and our sales partners to drive demand and create new business opportunities. Simultaneously we double down on the development of our people; creating career paths that allow reps to move through the SDR org and into more strategic roles that align with their future career aspirations.

As an SDR Manager, you’re focused on coaching and developing your regional reps. Building pipeline, managing processes, and focusing on per rep production is vital.

What You Will Do


Top of funnel leader that can execute on business needs. 
Able to leverage data to ensure that SLA’s and KPI’s are hit daily. 
Working side by side with your reps and coaching them how to handle objections and pitch Rippling in order to book demos with prospects. 
Motivates your reps to learn and grow daily preparing them for their next sales role. 
Strong leader that owns a specific function and is able to translate the needs of the business throughout their org. 
Heavily involved in hiring top talent for the SDR organization
Displaying cross functional empathy and able to deliver high level and tactical feedback across the orgs. 
Consistently drive the business to achieve and exceed revenue targets. 


What You Will Need


2+ years in an SDR Organization and 1+ years in SDR Leadership. 
Proficiency in SDR Tech Stack: Outreach, Salesloft, Mixmax, Salesforce, LI Sales Navigator, Zoominfo, Lusha, LeadIQ, SalesIntel, Gong/Chorus, Guru/Highspot. 
Experience in Enterprise SaaS with multi product selling distribution. 
Experience building an Outbound program or executing an outbound strategy that involves multichannel approaches tracked heavily by input/output metrics. 
Excellent abilities to manage at the ground level while also able to zoom out and define and execute on broader business initiatives. 
A deep understanding of scaling orgs in fast-paced environments. 
Experience in change management.

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The split for this team is 70/30. description:

Job Title: Digital Marketing Strategist / Account Manager




About the Company:

Our client is a dynamic, fast-paced digital marketing and sales firm rooted in strong values and a faith-inspired mission. They are a community of creative thinkers, proactive problem-solvers, and growth-minded professionals working to drive real impact through innovation and collaboration.




Job Description:

As a Digital Marketing Strategist / Account Manager, you will play a critical role in managing client relationships, owning account management responsibilities, planning strategic marketing initiatives, and guiding internal teams to deliver exceptional results. You will collaborate directly with clients, support cross-functional teams, and partner with Executive Leadership to determine the best paths forward.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Work 1-on-1 with clients to develop comprehensive marketing plans.

• Understand client goals, translate them into actionable strategies, and ensure deliverables align with expectations.

• Report progress to internal teams and help ensure tasks stay on track.

• Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, building strong, trusted relationships.

• Lead regular client check-ins, status updates, and strategy conversations.

• Ensure client needs, expectations, deadlines, and priorities are clearly communicated to the internal team.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve client results, strengthen relationships, and add value.

• Support client retention by maintaining consistent communication, accountability, and a high level of service.

• Escalate client concerns, blockers, or strategic needs to leadership when appropriate.

• Coordinate with creative, content, web, paid media, and leadership teams to keep projects moving forward.

• Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and client requests to ensure work is completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare meeting agendas, recap notes, next steps, and follow-ups after client calls.

• Help manage client feedback, approvals, and scope conversations with clarity and professionalism.

• Keep internal teams aligned on priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

• Help ensure client communications are timely, professional, and organized.

• Track project status and flag potential risks, delays, or changes in scope.

• Support and oversee email campaigns, including setup, optimization, and reporting.

• Conduct data analysis and prepare performance reports for clients and leadership.

• Assist in sales enablement efforts through strategic planning, tool setup, and content alignment.

• Provide direction or oversight on SEO, social media management, paid digital spend, and general web technologies.

• Help connect marketing performance insights to strategic client recommendations.

• Have a solid understanding of how the CRM works and how information is organized.

• Manage HubSpot to support the sales, marketing, and customer service teams.

• Set up and monitor basic automated tasks and simple processes in the CRM.

• Keep the database clean, organized, and up to date.

• Create easy-to-understand reports and dashboards to show overall progress.

• Troubleshoot common HubSpot issues and help team members use the platform effectively.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience in digital strategy, marketing management, account management, client services, or a CRM-focused role.

• Strong understanding of marketing databases, CRMs, and workflow architecture; HubSpot experience strongly preferred.

• Experience managing client relationships, expectations, timelines, and deliverables.

• Ability to translate complex data and client needs into clear, actionable plans.

• Strong communication and presentation skills for client-facing interactions.

• Familiarity with key digital marketing functions, including email, SEO, paid media, social, and web strategy.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and moving pieces.

• Ability to confidently navigate new tools, technologies, and client environments.




Preferred Skills:

• Strong HubSpot experience is highly beneficial and preferred.




Personality:

• A proactive, adaptable mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

• A commitment to Our client’s core values and a desire to contribute meaningfully to a mission-driven team.

• HubSpot experience strongly preferred.

• Marketing databases, CRMs, and workflow architecture.

title: Business development hunter
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

DiDi is the world's largest mobility technology platform. With over 10 years in the market, we are the leading company in smart transportation, food delivery, and app-based payment services. Every day, we make life easier and better for millions of people.

By joining DiDi, you will become part of an open, inclusive, and diverse community of more than 12,000 employees worldwide. From day one, you will find a collaborative global culture where your responsibilities have a direct impact on the company's strategy and growth.

In this role, you'll be...

The main mission of a Hunter is to drive driver acquisition through field sales. Your job will be to actively approach prospective drivers, especially those currently active in the industry—in high-potential field channels such as shopping centers, high-traffic areas, and transport stations. We are looking for profiles with a strong commercial orientation, persuasive ability, and a proactive mindset, who enjoy face-to-face contact and are successful in convincing drivers to join DiDi. This position will be key to the strategic growth of DiDi's driver base in your city. Responsibilities:

Prospect and approach potential drivers in field channels (shopping centers, events, high-traffic areas).

Persuasively present DiDi's value proposition to convince drivers active in the industry to migrate to the platform.

Build and manage strong relationships with partners and spaces that enable driver acquisition.

Execute acquisition strategies to meet and exceed established goals.

Follow up and report results, ensuring accuracy in CRM systems.

Provide feedback on market dynamics, competitor strategies, and new opportunities for frictionless recruitment.

Represent DiDi with professionalism, enthusiasm, and consistency in the field.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Bachelor's degree desirable (not mandatory).

3+ years of experience in field sales, business development, or driver acquisition (ideally in mobility, retail, or mass consumer goods).

Hunter mindset: proactive, competitive, resilient, and autonomous.

Proven track record of meeting ambitious commercial goals.

Excellent persuasion, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.

Ability to work in dynamic and fast-paced environments with clear deadlines.

Availability to work in the field in different areas of the city (80% field work).

Basic knowledge of Excel and CRM.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

Performance Creative Strategy | Paid Social | Growth Marketing | Creative Testing




Role Overview

One of our clients is looking for a Performance Creative Strategist / Paid Media & Creative Strategy Manager to bridge paid media, creative strategy, consumer insights, and performance analytics.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on DTC or consumer brand growth marketer with strong paid social experience, particularly Meta, and a proven track record of using creative testing and performance data to drive customer acquisition and profitable growth.




Experience: 7+ years




Key Responsibilities







Media & Growth Optimization

Own performance across key customer acquisition channels, including Meta and other paid social platforms.
Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale, and ROAS.
Partner with leadership to establish growth objectives, investment priorities, and performance expectations.
Evaluate creative performance alongside media performance to identify opportunities for optimization.







Creative Performance Analysis

Conduct creative performance audits using metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS.
Identify trends across messaging, hooks, offers, formats, creators, audiences, and visual execution.
Build reporting frameworks that translate performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
Develop hypotheses and testing strategies to improve creative effectiveness and customer acquisition.







Creative Strategy & Testing

Develop clear creative briefs based on consumer insights, channel learnings, and performance data.
Build structured testing roadmaps covering concepts, hooks, formats, messaging, offers, and creative angles.
Partner with creative teams, content creators, designers, copywriters, agencies, and influencers to execute creative briefs.
Establish repeatable processes for capturing and applying creative learnings to future campaigns.







Cross-Functional Collaboration

Act as the connection point between media buying, creative development, analytics, and creator/affiliate marketing.
Partner with internal teams and external agencies to align messaging, creative priorities, and testing strategies.
Establish a complete performance feedback loop: Performance Data → Creative Insights → Brief → Development → Testing → Optimization → Scale.







Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, creative strategy, or a related field.
Proven track record of scaling customer acquisition within a DTC, e-commerce, or consumer brand environment.
Hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns, particularly Meta Ads.
Strong experience developing creative testing frameworks and continuous optimization programs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable creative strategies.
Strong understanding of creative and media performance metrics, including CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, and engagement metrics.
Experience working with creators and creative teams, including designers, copywriters, content creators, agencies, and brand teams.







Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high-growth, digitally native, founder-led, or founder-influenced consumer brands.
Experience with subscription, e-commerce, or repeat-purchase business models.
Familiarity with Meta, TikTok, Google, Shopify, Amazon, and marketing attribution platforms.
Experience managing creative testing at scale across multiple messages, formats, creators, and audience segments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidates will have worked at the intersection of:

Performance marketing
Paid social
Direct-response creative
Creative strategy
Consumer psychology
Growth analytics
Creator and influencer marketing

The ideal candidate is not solely a traditional media buyer or traditional creative strategist. They should be comfortable using performance data to identify what is working, translating those insights into creative direction, and building a disciplined experimentation process.







What Success Looks Like

Establish a repeatable creative testing framework with clear hypotheses, learning agendas, and decision rules.

About the job

¡En Localiza&Co estamos en busca de personas entusiastas para unirse a nuestro equipo como Key Account Seminuevos en Cancún! Nuestro objetivo es formar un equipo de talento apasionado por las ventas y relaciones comerciales a través de altos estándares de negociación para líneas de negocio corporativas.




Objetivo de la posición:

Planificar, dirigir y supervisar las estrategias comerciales de venta de vehículos en una región determinada, asegurando el cumplimiento de metas de ventas, rentabilidad, participación de mercado y satisfacción del cliente. 

 

Principales actividades:

Definir, diseñar e implementar estrategias comerciales para el segmento de cuentas clave en seminuevos, a través del análisis de objetivos corporativos, desempeño histórico de ventas, comportamiento del mercado y colaboración con áreas internas, para asegurar el crecimiento sostenido de ventas, la participación de mercado y la alineación con los objetivos estratégicos del negocio.
Garantizar altos niveles de satisfacción y experiencia del cliente, dando seguimiento a la calidad del servicio, atendiendo requerimientos y resolviendo incidencias oportunamente, para fomentar la retención de clientes, la reputación del negocio y la recurrencia de compra.
Monitorear tendencias del mercado automotriz de seminuevos y el comportamiento de la competencia, a través de análisis de información de mercado, benchmarking y retroalimentación de clientes, para anticiparse a cambios del entorno, ajustar estrategias comerciales y mantener la competitividad del negocio.
Establecer metas de venta para las cuentas asignadas y monitorea su cumplimiento, mediante la definición de KPIs, elaboración de planes comerciales y seguimiento periódico del desempeño de cada cuenta, para garantizar el logro de objetivos de volumen, ingresos y rentabilidad del canal.
Analizar indicadores clave del negocio como ventas, margen, inventario y rotación, utilizando herramientas analíticas, reportes comerciales y dashboards de desempeño, para identificar oportunidades, riesgos y áreas de mejora que permitan optimizar los resultados comerciales.
Diseñar e implementar planes de acción orientados a incrementar ventas y mejorar el desempeño de cuentas clave, a partir de diagnósticos comerciales, detección de brechas de desempeño y coordinación con equipos internos, para maximizar la productividad de las cuentas y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos establecidos. 

 

Requisitos mínimos: 

• Licenciatura en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios o afín. Concluida (con título/cédula o carta pasante) 

• Experiencia mínima de 3 a 5 años en ventas dentro del sector automotriz (indispensable)

• Experiencia en estrategias comerciales

• Manejo de indicadores clave del negocio como ventas, margen, inventario y rotación 

• Excel avanzado y paquetería Office, o uso de CRM. 

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación y persuasión. Manejo de socios comerciales

• Disponibilidad de horario

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la región

description:
About the job




Job Title: Internal Sales Representative / Appointment Setter
Work Hours: Full-time (40 hours/week)
Schedule/Timezone: Pacific Time (Client based in San Diego, California)
Location: 100% Remote




Overview

Are you a skilled sales communicator who thrives on turning warm leads into loyal customers? Step into a high-impact role where your phone presence directly drives business growth during peak season!

We are a premier provider of permanent outdoor, architectural, and landscape lighting solutions based in Southern California, specializing in smart, app-controlled residential and commercial installations. As we enter our busiest season of the year—spanning from Halloween through Christmas—we are seeking a proactive, experienced Internal Sales Representative / Appointment Setter to manage our rapidly growing lead volume. This is a dynamic, client-facing role that goes far beyond basic scheduling: you’ll engage directly with customers, assess their lighting needs, qualify leads, and either close sales over the phone or seamlessly match clients with our field sales experts.




Key Responsibilities

Answer incoming prospective customer calls and conduct initial needs assessments.
Qualify incoming leads to determine whether they require an appointment or a direct sales call.
Lead phone-based consultative sales conversations to understand project scope and close deals directly for customers preferring remote quotes.
Schedule qualified appointments for the field sales team.
Manage and maintain CRM systems to ensure accurate pipeline tracking (GoHighLevel for marketing leads; Jobber for transactional workflow).
Follow up consistently on pending customer quotes and nurture prospects through the sales pipeline.
Execute proactive outbound outreach and lead generation initiatives when required.




Must-Have Requirements

3–5+ years of successful experience in sales or high-volume appointment setting.
Excellent phone communication skills with clear, professional spoken English tailored for U.S. client interactions.
Proven track record of handling customer objections and successfully closing sales over the phone.
Strong organizational skills, keen attention to detail, and top-tier pipeline management.
A proactive, self-sufficient mindset with the drive to take initiative and deliver results without constant supervision.




Nice-to-Have Requirements

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, specifically GoHighLevel and Jobber.
Previous background in the home services or outdoor lighting industries.
Strong foundational knowledge of customer service excellence and direct sales best practices.
Comfort and agility working independently while collaborating effectively within a small, tight-knit team.

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Santander (www.santander.com) está evolucionando de ser una marca global de alto impacto a una organización impulsada por la tecnología, y las personas están en el centro de este camino. Estamos buscando un/a Gerente de Procesos y análisis de datos

Diseña, desarrolla e implementa técnicas de preparación, procesamiento de datos y transformaciones para validar, medir y optimizar los diversos indicadores del negocio.

Desarrolla e implementa procesos y procedimientos automatizados y documentados con el objetivo de medir, optimizar e implementar mejoras en las acciones comerciales, contactabilidad, priorización de prospectos, carterización, segmentación de clientes, actualización de expedientes e indicadores de fuga que ayude a la toma de decisiones con base en datos de manera continua y escalable.

Experiencia profesional de 3 a 5 años en rol similar

Idioma inglés Intermedio Avanzado

Las habilidades clave incluyen fuerte conocimiento y habilidades de ingeniería de datos (bases de datos relacionales o NoSQL, herramientas ETL), software de visualización y reporteo (Tableau, PowerBI), así como lenguajes de programación (Python, R, etc).

About PayJoy

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. This role

This is an ownership role: you generate your own pipeline, drive deals end-to-end from first contact to signed contract and ramp, and are fully accountable for landing new business.

Hunt and close new business, owning the full sales cycle end-to-end — prospecting, qualifying, pitching, negotiating, and signing new strategic partners — with full accountability for hitting new-business and revenue targets. 
Generate and drive your own pipeline proactively, building a robust prospect list of high-profitability accounts and distribution channels and converting them into signed deals without waiting for inbound leads.

Continuously analyze market and sector trends to sharpen targeting, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and stay ahead of competitor moves in a highly competitive market. 
Support your manager and the wider team by sharing learnings, feeding into playbooks and processes, and contributing to the tools and programs that make new-business acquisition more repeatable.

Hunter mentality. You are energized by chasing and landing new deals. You are comfortable with cold outreach, self-sourced pipeline, and the persistence that closing net-new business demands. 
Independent and self-managed. You operate autonomously, structure your own priorities, and drive outcomes with minimal oversight. 
Ownership mindset. You treat your pipeline and targets as your own business, take full accountability for results, and follow through end-to-end. 
Highly organized. You manage a complex pipeline, multiple prospects, and competing deadlines without dropping details. 
Strong negotiation skills. You structure and close complex, high-value agreements that balance aggressive growth with sustainable, mutual value. 
Analytical and problem-solving ability. You identify problems, propose innovative and effective solutions, adapt quickly to market changes, and make informed decisions under pressure. 
Results-driven. You thrive in a high-change, high-pressure environment focused on expanding phone finance services.

title: Marketing Manager, Campaign Management
skills: Standardizing Campaign Processes: Implement and enforce a unified set of campaign execution process flows and best practices across all teams and regions, so that every marketing campaign (from planning to launch to post-campaign reporting) follows the same playbook. This involves defining clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), service-level agreements (SLAs) for deliverables, and quality checkpoints. The goal is to ensure every campaign is executed efficiently and “on time, on brand, and on budget”, regardless of which team or region runs it. The Manager will administer quality control over all campaign projects, verifying that essential steps (briefs, reviews, approvals, etc.) are completed for each campaign. They also continuously refine processes to improve speed (“speed to market”) without sacrificing quality or consistency.
Leadership & Team Management: Provide strong leadership, coaching, and direction to 10 Campaign Managers.

Financial Discipline & MDF Management: A critical part of the role is financial oversight of campaign budgets and Marketing Development Funds (MDF). The manager will track all campaign budgets and vendor-provided funds, ensuring budget accuracy, timely utilization, and full compliance with funding requirements. They establish a “zero-tolerance” policy for letting allocated MDF expire unused – which is essential since many vendor funds expire if not utilized within a set timeframe (often 12 months).

Operational Excellence & Capacity Management: Manage the overall campaign production pipeline and capacity planning. With 20+ reports handling numerous simultaneous campaigns, the leader must allocate resources optimally across teams, balancing workloads and adjusting assignments when high-priority projects or “crunch times” arise. They will use tools (like Workfront) and data to monitor each team’s capacity and productivity, ensuring no team is overloaded and that campaigns are delivered per the agreed timeline.

Marketing Technology/Operations team to ensure that systems like Workfront, CRM, and analytics tools are configured to support campaign processes and reporting needs (for instance, integrating Workfront with financial systems like Anaplan or Oracle to sync budget data automatically).

Performance Tracking & ROI Accountability: Ensure that campaign outcomes are measured and communicated in terms of business impact. The Manager will oversee the development of standardized reporting dashboards and processes so that each campaign manager (and their stakeholders) can easily see key metrics like lead volumes, conversion rates through the funnel, pipeline generated, and ROI for their campaigns.
10 years in Marketing Ops, Project Management, or Agency Account Leadership.
5+ years managing large, multi-functional teams (10+ people)
Experience with MDF/Co-op funding and vendor-partner marketing models.

Beyond just using tools, understand API integrations between Work Management (Workfront), CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics), and Marketing Automation (Marketo/HubSpot). Know how data flows from a "Brief" to a "Lead" to a "Financial Claim.
Hands-on experience with enterprise financial software (e.g., Oracle, SAP, or Anaplan) to track MDF allocations, net margins, and cost recovery.
Technical understanding of multi-touch attribution (MTA) to ensure the ROI reported to vendors and leadership is accurate and defensible.
Experience managing Internationalization (i18n) and Localization (l10n) workflows is a huge plus. Know how a campaign flow changes when moving from North America to EMEA or LATAM.
Experience with Marketing Development Funds (MDF) "push back" on vendors regarding proof-of-performance requirements or negotiate better funding terms based on the ROI data they’ve collected.
The ideal candidate has a proven framework for triage—deciding which campaigns get resources when capacity is peaked.

About the job

Social Media Community Manager

Location: Remote – Latin America

Schedule: Full-Time | 40 hours/week

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM ET

Compensation: $6-$8 per hour

Language: Fluent English & Spanish required




About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive, bilingual Social Media Community Manager to help a growing U.S.-based business stay connected with its online community, respond to prospective clients, and convert conversations into appointments.




This is not a traditional content-focused social media role. The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, whether through DMs, comments, WhatsApp, or phone calls, and knows how to turn conversations into meaningful business opportunities.




Key Responsibilities:

Monitor and respond to DMs, comments, messages, and inquiries across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
Engage authentically with followers and contacts through comments, greetings, friend requests, and other relationship-building activities.
Represent the business owner’s warm, friendly, and relationship-focused brand voice in online conversations.
Identify potential leads within incoming conversations and ask appropriate qualifying questions.
Enter and maintain lead information in the CRM.
Follow up consistently with prospective and existing clients.
Schedule qualified appointments directly on the calendar.
Re-engage older leads and contacts who may have fallen through the cracks.
Maintain organized records of conversations, follow-ups, and appointments.
Proactively identify missed messages, neglected leads, and opportunities requiring follow-up.
Suggest ways to improve communication, follow-up, and engagement processes.




Requirements

Fluent or near-native Spanish and strong professional English.
2+ years of experience in social media/community engagement or managing customer conversations through social platforms.
Comfortable communicating with potential clients
Strong relationship-building and conversational skills.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups simultaneously.
Proactive and comfortable working independently without waiting to be told what to do next.

Nice to Have:

Experience reactivating old leads or working from an existing CRM/database.
Experience with Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
Experience creating or maintaining chatbots and automated messaging workflows.
Familiarity with AI tools for customer communication and productivity.
Basic social media content creation or short-form video editing skills.




Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You may be a great fit if you have worked as a Community Manager, Social Media Engagement Specialist, or Customer Engagement Specialist and your experience crosses both digital communication.




We are especially interested in people who see an unanswered message, neglected lead, or missed opportunity and take initiative to do something about it.

title: Executive Assistant / Client Experience Manager to a Founder Who Actually Wants Reminders
skills: If you send a calendar invitation and 24 hours passes without acceptance, your first thought is "This is unfinished business" and not, "Well, I sent it."
If someone says, “I’ll try to get that done later this week,” a tiny part of your brain immediately wonders, "Cool... until the is day locked, it's unfinished business."
If you're waiting for an answer, completing your part does not make the loop disappear... until every loop is closed, this is unfinished business.

Manage the calendar and commitments from beginning to end - confirm meetings, notice missing information, chase unanswered invitations, check links and logistics, and make sure that 'scheduled' actually means happening.
Run a daily 1:1 - keep it moving, capture commitments, and turn wandering conversation into next steps.
Maintain and improve the systems that hold active clients, prospects, tasks, meetings, and follow-ups.
Notice when someone is waiting too long for a response and do something about it.

Manage reminders, commitments, and projects... giving special attention to the things that this leader's ADHD brain has dumped into the bucket of "Decision Paralysis" and "Executive Dysfunction" by scheduling a Body Double work session to ensure that there is no unfinished business. If you're not familiar with Neurodivergent Body Doubling, look it up and tell me, in your own words, what you think about this and how you might approach it. Yes... this is a test to see if you're paying attention.
Coordinate travel, events, speaking engagements, clients, documents, purchases, receipts, and the assorted details that make a business look effortless from the outside.
Support client communication in a voice that is warm, direct, clear, human, and very much not corporate blathering.

Use tools like Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Calendly, Zoom, Fathom, and AI tools including Claude - prior experience is nice but not mandatory as long as you are comfortable learning technology and curious enough to reach for a better tool when you find one.
Document the systems you learn and build, because efficiency is important, especially in the age of AI when things must happen quickly. Work smarter, not harder.
You have a real system for tracking things... not just “I’m very organized"... there is a difference.
You notice that something that was perfect yesterday might need to be lovingly adjusted today because humans are complicated.
You follow up...and then you follow up again - warmly of course because there's a difference between caring and being controlling or irritated.
You notice open loops and you naturally ask questions when something does not make sense because it makes more sense to surface a problem early than quietly hope it resolves itself.
You are comfortable saying, “I need an answer on this" and you can run a meeting without needing to be the expert in the room.

You can hear ten minutes of conversation and figure out what the other person actually needs to know and what actually needs to be done and you know how to lead with the bottom line in an email instead of making someone excavate it from paragraph seven.
You really like working with people because there is a difference between professional communication and effective communication.

You notice moods, wins, insecurity, and excitement... you notice when somebody needs a nudge versus when they need five minutes to think about the variables that they're having trouble finding the words for.

You can laugh - this matters a lot because this leader genuinely loves his work. There is play in this company and there will be fast days, strange days, deeply satisfying days, and occasional days where everyone looks at what just happened and laughs before getting back to tidying up the unfinished business.

He is smart, warm, funny, fast-moving, deeply relational, often distracted, and very open about his struggles with ADHD. It's his superpower but we don't get the superpower without the Kryptonite and you... YOU are his antidote. (I'm nerdy so if this reference doesn't land, it's from Superman.)




He wants reminders, he wants you to tell him when he has wandered away from the point, he wants you to ask the obvious questions, he wants you to disagree with him respectfully, and if he says, “I’ll try to do that this week,” he would genuinely love for you to ask him what day because until it's done... it's unfinished business... and that bugs you.

You follow up...and then you follow up again - warmly of course because there's a difference between caring and being controlling or irritated.
You notice open loops and you naturally ask questions when something does not make sense because it makes more sense to surface a problem early than quietly hope it resolves itself.
You are comfortable saying, “I need an answer on this" and you can run a meeting without needing to be the expert in the room.
You can hear ten minutes of conversation and figure out what the other person actually needs to know and what actually needs to be done and you know how to lead with the bottom line in an email instead of making someone excavate it from paragraph seven.
You really like working with people because there is a difference between professional communication and effective communication.
You notice moods, wins, insecurity, and excitement... you notice when somebody needs a nudge versus when they need five minutes to think about the variables that they're having trouble finding the words for.
You can laugh - this matters a lot because this leader genuinely loves his work. There is play in this company and there will be fast days, strange days, deeply satisfying days, and occasional days where everyone looks at what just happened and laughs before getting back to tidying up the unfinished business. 




The Essentials




This is a full-time, remote, salaried position that pays between $1200-1500 USD/month, and we want to be clear about what that does and does not mean. 




Salary does not mean you become responsible for the business 24 hours a day or that invisible overtime is an expectation, and sacrificing your health to prove dedication is not a winning strategy. 




For a leader and a business that is focused on culture and team excellence, applying the tenants of the work itself is part of the work.




You will have agreed working hours, and having a life outside of that is a must. That said, this leader is located in the United States on Pacific Time, and this role does require working PST business hours. For some of you, Pacific hours may mean an earlier or later day than you're used to... while for others, this may mean overnight hours. 




We are not going to pretend that sleeping during the day is effortless or that everyone can simply adjust. Some genuinely prefer overnight work - their family rhythm accommodates it, their body tolerates it well, and they have built a life that makes those hours sustainable.




Please do not convince yourself that you can tolerate a schedule that you already know will make you miserable. We are looking for someone who will see this through to retirement... for both of you, so this schedule needs to work for your actual life, your health, your relationships, your home environment, and your sleep.




You’ll need excellent written and spoken English because communication is essential since you'll be the main contact for executives, clients, prospects, and partners.




You’ll need reliable internet and a realistic backup plan if connectivity or power fails and you’ll need a good computer, camera, microphone or headset, and a quiet enough environment to work and join calls professionally. Handling confidential business, client, calendar, financial, and account information is part of this, so discretion and good security habits are essential.




I do not care if you have a background in executive assistance or office administration - some of my best hires have come from people who have super unique backgrounds combined with a drive to learn and grow. 




My role in this hire is not a meet/greet/disappear role - I stick around for 30 days to talk, plan, build, and support you. I'm here to make sure that this relationship is successful and epic.




If everything here is your vibe, email me with your resume and a short paragraph about why you want this and why everything in your life has brought you to this moment. 




Lead Vibrantly,




Eryn Anitavi

title: Founding Sales Lead
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Founding Sales Lead




About the Company:

Our client pushes brand creative across a creator network, analyzes performance data, and identifies winning content to be used as ads before paid spend is allocated. They aim to eliminate the guesswork in ad creative selection for DTC brands.




Job Description:

This role is responsible for building and scaling the top of the sales funnel. Currently, growth relies on relationships and founder-led selling, which is not scalable. The successful candidate will own the pipeline development process, transforming a smaller base of clients into a larger one by establishing a scalable sales process. This is a foundational role where the individual will be responsible for creating the sales playbook, messaging, and channel strategy.

The market is large and the category is emerging, with a product that is proven to work and can be demonstrated with data. The role offers the opportunity to significantly impact the company's early growth and sales infrastructure.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Execute multi-channel outbound sales activities (email, LinkedIn, phone) targeting DTC and ecommerce brands.

• Minimize inbound lead response time to ensure the company is the fastest to engage with potential buyers.

• Leverage existing networks (investors, partners, past clients) to generate warm leads and secure meetings.

• Conduct thorough research on target brands' existing creative strategies to personalize outreach.

• Ensure clean and detailed notes are passed to the next stage of the sales process for effective follow-up.

• Maintain CRM data integrity, ensuring all activities are accurately recorded.

• Provide market feedback on objections, effective messaging, and list performance to inform strategy.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 1-3 years of experience in a sales development or account executive role.

• Experience selling to marketing, ecommerce, or agency buyers is preferred.

• Demonstrated passion for sales.

• Ability to manage and maintain over 100 live accounts simultaneously.

• Capacity to receive feedback and adapt behavior quickly.

• Interest in consumer brands and short-form video content.




Preferred Skills:

• Prior experience selling agency or marketing services.

• Experience building sales lists and running outreach sequences independently.

• Existing network within the DTC, ecommerce, or performance marketing sectors.




Personality:

• Proactive and self-starting attitude.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Adaptable and eager to learn.

• Results-oriented and driven.




Software & Tools:

• CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

• Sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft)

• LinkedIn Sales Navigator




Schedule:

Full-time

Remote or In-office in Williamsburg




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.
